design: Older dark-skinned herald with a broad low brow, weathered angular four mandibles and pale dreadlocks looped loosely behind the crown. White travel ceremonial mantle with hood resting back to reveal entire face, red internal lining and long slim front banner strip. One hand holds a short curved bronze call horn near hip, other grasps mantle clasp. Dark slate mottled scales.
